description: This Java class contains step definitions for Cucumber tests related to database validation within the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods for setup, data operations (insert, update, delete, query), assertions, and cleanup, all focused on testing database interactions in an automated testing environment.

classes.name: DatabaseValidationSteps
classes.description: Provides Cucumber step definitions for database validation scenarios, including setup, data modification, verification, and cleanup operations.

methods.name: theDatabaseConnectionIsConfiguredForTheCurrentEnvironment
methods.description: Verifies if the database connection is properly configured for the current environment; skips scenario if not configured.

methods.name: theTableExistsInTheDatabase
methods.description: Checks whether a specified table exists in the database.

methods.name: aRecordExistsInTableWhereColumnEqualsValue
methods.description: Ensures a record matching specific column and value exists before executing tests.

methods.name: noRecordExistsInTableWhereColumnEqualsValue
methods.description: Ensures no record matches the specified condition, cleaning up if necessary.

methods.name: iInsertARecordIntoTableWithColumnValue
methods.description: Inserts a single-column record into the table.

methods.name: iInsertARecordIntoTableWithValues
methods.description: Inserts a record with multiple columns specified as key-value pairs.

methods.name: iUpdateTableSetColumnWhereCondition
methods.description: Updates a specific column in a table where a condition matches.

methods.name: iUpdateTableSetValuesWhereCondition
methods.description: Updates multiple columns in a table based on a condition.

methods.name: iDeleteFromTableWhereCondition
methods.description: Deletes a record from a table where a specified condition is met.

methods.name: iExecuteTheQuery
methods.description: Executes a custom SQL query and stores results.

methods.name: iExecuteTheQueryWithParameter
methods.description: Executes a query with a single parameter.

methods.name: theOperationShouldAffectNRows
methods.description: Verifies that the last DML operation affected an expected number of rows.

methods.name: aRecordShouldExistInTableWhereColumnEquals
methods.description: Asserts that a record exists with given condition.

methods.name: noRecordShouldExistInTableWhereColumnEquals
methods.description: Asserts that no record exists with given condition.

methods.name: theValueOfColumnInTableShouldBe
methods.description: Checks that a specific column's value matches expectation for a row matching a condition.

methods.name: theCountOfRecordsShouldBe
methods.description: Verifies the count of records matching a condition equals expected.

methods.name: theQueryResultShouldContainNRows
methods.description: Checks that the last query returned the expected number of rows.

methods.name: theQueryResultShouldNotBeEmpty
methods.description: Asserts that the last query result is not empty.

methods.name: theQueryResultShouldBeEmpty
methods.description: Asserts that the last query result is empty.

methods.name: theDatabaseShouldBeAccessible
methods.description: Verifies database connectivity.

methods.name: iCleanUpTheRecordInTableWhereColumnEquals
methods.description: Deletes a record used during testing for cleanup.

methods.name: generateUniqueId
methods.description: Generates a thread-safe unique integer ID for use in parallel tests.

methods.name: parseColumnValues
methods.description: Parses comma-separated column=value pairs into a map for data insertion/update.
